## Description

Reconciliation table: medicine, chart, patient-reported, other source (HIS column hidden until P7), conflict flag, decision Keep / Change / Stop (patient-only items: Add / Ignore). Summary "n of m decided · k sources disagree". "Confirm changes" disabled until every row has a decision; confirmed decisions update MEDICATION_STATEMENT review_state and feed the Rx composer (stop → discontinue line).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Confirm is disabled until all rows are decided (UI + API).
- [ ] **AC2.** Each decision records actor, time and reason for Stop/Change; history is kept.
- [ ] **AC3.** Conflicts are flagged with text (e.g. "atorvastatin active in chart, patient says stopped").
- [ ] **AC4.** Stopped medicines show as stopped with date in Patient 360 and the timeline.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
